title: Spark's Groove
logline: A shy, outdated robot overcomes his social anxiety at a glittering rooftop party when a vibrant dancer teaches him how to find his rhythm.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: A shy, slightly rusty robot with expressive LED eyes who longs to fit in.

characters.name: Beatrix
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant, neon-accented dancing robot who is confident and welcoming.

scenes.title: Wallflower Spark
scenes.summary: Spark stands nervously in the corner of a bustling rooftop party, watching other robots dance under the neon lights.

scenes.title: The Invitation
scenes.summary: Beatrix notices Spark's hesitation, dances her way over to him with smooth, fluid motions, and extends a hand.

scenes.title: Clunky First Steps
scenes.summary: Spark takes her hand and tries to mimic her moves, but his gears grind and he accidentally executes a stiff, awkward jerk.

scenes.title: Finding the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Beatrix adjusts her style to match his mechanical nature, encouraging him. Spark finds a unique, rhythmic robotic pop-and-lock groove.

scenes.title: Rooftop Royalty
scenes.summary: The surrounding crowd circles around them, cheering as Spark and Beatrix perform a synchronized high-energy dance routine.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
